newsitem.title: USA: Mobil says to buy 3.6 mln bbls Iraqi crude.
newsitem.headline: Mobil says to buy 3.6 mln bbls Iraqi crude.

text.p: Mobil Corp will buy 3.6 million barrels of Iraqi crude oil under the U.N. "oil-for-food" agreement, a company spokesman said on Thursday.
"We will be purchasing 3.6 million barrels of Iraqi crude between now and December 4," the spokesman said.
The oil-for-food deal allows Baghdad to sell $2.14 billion worth of crude from June to December in two separate 90-day periods of $1.07 billion each.
Mobil on September 1 is scheduled to lift one million barrels of Basrah Light crude from the Mina al-Bakr terminal in the Mideast Gulf, according to shipping sources.
The other U.S. companies that are slated to lift Iraqi oil are Chevron, Coastal and privately held trader Bayoil.
Contracts for more than 70 million barrels of Iraqi crude had been approved by the United Nations through Wednesday.
